name: mcpward
stderr:
Usage: mcpward [options] [command]

Black-box security & contract testing for MCP servers — catch rug-pulls, tool
poisoning, and schema drift before your agents do.

Options:
  -V, --version          output the version number
  -c, --config <path>    Path to config file (default: "mcpward.yaml")
  -r, --reporter <type>  Reporter type: console, json, junit, sarif, markdown
                         (default: "console")
  -o, --out <path>       Output file path for reporters
  --json                 Shorthand for --reporter json
  -v, --verbose          Verbose output
  --update-golden        Write golden snapshot files instead of comparing
                         against them
  --pr-comment           Post/update the report as a GitHub PR comment (needs
                         GITHUB_TOKEN with pull-requests: write)
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  init                   Scaffold a new mcpward.yaml configuration file
  run                    Run all configured checks against the MCP server
  baseline               Capture current server surface to lockfile
  diff                   Show drift between current server and baseline
  help [command]         display help for command
